## Decisions log
- 2026-06 experiment on #227: tried `priority: -1` on layer component dirs; it did NOT change resolution — the app dir beats layers at equal priority, and a negative priority is ignored.

tickets.title: Let the app's own components win over the layer's
tickets.body:
## Hypothesis
We think that setting `priority: -1` on the package component dirs makes the app's Card win.

Rule: an app component always beats a layer component of the same name.

## 🧪 How to test
Test: components.test.ts — app Card beats package Card.
